secrets: the customer's secret store; the handover pack names the secret, never its value
backups: decisions store copied before each release; RPO 24 hours; restore drill before go-live

triage_slow.symptom: more than 1 in 4 triage requests take over 1 s
triage_slow.first_check: open one slow log line; its trace_id shows the slowest span
triage_slow.mitigation: do not restart triage: the time is in the orders API call; send that team the trace_id
triage_slow.verify: one /triage call answers in under 1 s and the alert clears within 5 minutes
triage_slow.escalate_to: orders API on-call (tier 2), with the time window

erp_auth_failed.symptom: triage answers 502; logs show erp_error with status 401 or 403
erp_auth_failed.first_check: ask the orders API team if the reader secret was rotated; never paste a secret into a ticket
erp_auth_failed.mitigation: put the current secret in the secret store and redeploy the same image tag
erp_auth_failed.verify: one /triage call answers 200 and no new erp_error lines appear
erp_auth_failed.escalate_to: identity team (tier 2) if the reader account is locked
